activities.question: Explain the main idea of Chapter 10.
activities.instructions: Use the source-based options to complete this activity.

correctItems.text: Paheli and Boojho had also set up the game by connecting an electric circuit as suggested in Class VI.
They had lots of fun trying it out with their families and friends.
They enjoyed it so much that they decided to suggest it to a cousin of theirs who stayed in a different town.
So, Paheli made a neat drawing showing how the various electric components were to be connected (Fig.10.1).

activities.modelAnswer: Paheli and Boojho had also set up the game by connecting an electric circuit as suggested in Class VI. They had lots of fun trying it out with their families and friends.
